subject: spelling: cannot (#2242)
reason: The change is a spelling fix ('can not' -> 'cannot') confined to code comments, serverLog message strings that are only written to the server log (bio.c, debug.c, io_threads.c, rdma.c), test module comments, and Tcl test names/comments. No client-visible reply, error message, config option, protocol output, or code path changes, so no behaviour exists to test and a compared command sequence could show no difference.
